name: com.gptshopltd/ukcheck
title: UKCheck: UK company checks
description: Vet UK companies: Companies House status, overdue filings, charges and UK Sanctions List screen.

tools.name: search_uk_companies
tools.description: Use when you need the Companies House number of a live UK company from its name. Free. Dissolved and post-snapshot companies are excluded. Returns up to 10 live UK companies whose name starts with the query.

query.description: Company name or its start, e.g. "Tesco Stores"

tools.name: uk_company_check
tools.description: Use when you must vet a live UK company (supplier, customer, counterparty, lead): registry status, age, overdue accounts or confirmation statement, dormant flag, outstanding charges, previous names, and an FCDO UK Sanctions List name screen, with sources. Costs 1 credit on found companies (404 not_found does not deduct a credit). Pass Authorization: Bearer ukc_... header or api_key argument (buy at https://ukcheck.gptshopltd.com/#pricing).

company_number.description: Companies House number, e.g. 00445790 or SC123456

api_key.description: Optional if sent in Authorization: Bearer header; UKCheck key starting ukc_
